svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.latitude-parallels-globe-plan", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "Teach latitude circles in a front orthographic equator-centred globe,R50mm. Selected -60,-30,0,30,60degree circles project to horizontal chords with y=-Rsin(phi),halfwidth=Rcos(phi); north up. No continent or all latitude circles drawn. Equator dashed4/3mm and nativeIndex sparser7mm pitch by taught key; no numeric/Braille labels. OriginalR40proposal uniformly scaled1.25. Not exact source752 or physical recognition approval.", "geometry_exception": "Compatible Swell/ViewPlus1.4mm line contours,latitude-equator1mm dashed4/3mm. NativeIndex1.2mm dots,3.1mm globalguard;logicalanchors preserved,otherpoints omitted when near. Equator7mm pitch versusother3.5mm by explicitly taught convention. No inherent latitude/elevation/Braille/height recognition.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphicdots,not Braille. Logical contour/limb junctions anchored once;optionalnearpoints omitted with3.1mm guard. Latitude equator7mm pitch versus3.5mm other lines is a declared taught reference role,not quantitative height. Physical tracing pending.
